applicability: Whole-subject review answers and changed-file content answers read by one mounted review surface.
conditions: The answer was admitted, is whole (not a page) and carried no refresh identity; content answers are kept only when state is content with an expansion.
Both stores are bounded LRU (24 reviews, 32 content answers) and live only as long as the mounted surface.
Whole-review reuse additionally requires no explicit review-input invalidation since admission; memoryChanged advances inputEpoch, clears the review store and requests a refresh.
Source-content reuse remains separately keyed to its exact source request; invalidateReviews does not itself clear that store.
exclusions: Paged and roster-continuation reads, which stay owned by the read cycle.
Refusals and failures, which are always asked again.
Re-validating a moved live candidate on return; the reader's refresh re-asks (O-R1-1, by design).
Content rendered outside a review surface, which has no cache.
The former unconditional no-request promise for a same-tree pair after explicit memory-input invalidation; an old input epoch is not a reusable answer.
statement: Within an unchanged retained comparison generation and review-input epoch, admitted whole-subject reviews and opened file content are reused on return. Refresh re-asks; explicit memory-input invalidation clears review reuse and rejects old-epoch completions, while a changed comparison generation clears both bounded surface-owned stores. Refusals and failures are not retained.
